host: node packages/emscripten-cache/cert/check.mjs --tarball <package.tgz | npm spec>: unpacks the tarball and checks its sysroot; then sets up the same emscripten 6.0.9 tree (tag + packages/wasm-emscripten/patches, scripts/emscripten-tree.sh) on emsdk 6.0.9's prebuilt clang and binaryen, points a FROZEN_CACHE at the package's sysroot (a symlink, as em-ensure-cache makes it) and stamp, and links and runs C and C++ programs under Node. A sysroot has no commands of its own.
checklist: every library in libs.txt is in sysroot/lib/wasm32-emscripten (crt1, crt1_reactor and 48 archives), each archive an ar file; sysroot/include/bits/alltypes.h has the 128-byte musl sigset_t (wasm-emscripten patch 0007); stamps/sysroot_install.stamp; EMSCRIPTEN_VERSION 6.0.9-git

no library names a build path (/home/, /Users/, /__w/, /private/var/): wasm-emscripten patch 0011 maps the cache and the llvm root in the DWARF, so the CI host-build and rebuild are byte-identical. 6.0.9-3 names /Users/trieloff/Developer/ai-ecoverse/slicc-emscripten/cache/sysroot/include (NEGATIVE.md)
with FROZEN_CACHE (nothing may be built), a C program links and prints sizeof(struct sigaction) 140; C++ with -fwasm-exceptions and with -fexceptions (JS) throws and catches a std::runtime_error
the libraries match the headers of the same 6.0.9 tree: a program calling epoll_create1 and ppoll links. 6.0.9-3's libc.a, built from an older emscripten's system libraries, lacks both (NEGATIVE.md)
